name: kaii-agent
description: A local-first AI task workbench for macOS.

scripts.test: npm run test:main && npm run test:renderer && npm run test:native && npm run test:package
scripts.test:renderer: node --experimental-strip-types --test --test-concurrency=1 tests/renderer/storage.test.mjs tests/renderer/restore-transaction.test.mjs tests/renderer/task-capsule.test.mjs tests/renderer/task-store.test.mjs tests/renderer/task-workbench.test.mjs tests/renderer/chat-layout.test.mjs tests/renderer/palette-prompts-backup.test.mjs tests/renderer/chart.test.mjs tests/renderer/export-document.test.mjs tests/renderer/math-toolbar.test.mjs tests/renderer/usage-export.test.mjs tests/renderer/batch-thirty.test.mjs tests/renderer/composer.test.mjs tests/renderer/outline-table.test.mjs tests/renderer/organize.test.mjs tests/renderer/instant.test.mjs tests/renderer/import-chatgpt.test.mjs tests/renderer/onboarding.test.mjs tests/renderer/public-copy.test.mjs tests/renderer/settings-copy.test.mjs
scripts.test:native: npm run build:native && bash tests/native/vision-helper.test.sh && bash tests/native/doc-helper.test.sh && bash tests/native/speech-helper.test.sh
scripts.test:package: npm run build && npm run build:native && node --test tests/package/build-artifacts.test.cjs
scripts.package:mac: npm test && npm run build:native && electron-builder --mac dir
scripts.package:dmg: npm test && npm run build:native && electron-builder --mac dmg
